failure_signature: OpenCode skill shipped without a valid YAML frontmatter or with a hand-written Engram RAG block using a forbidden v1 topic alias.
validated_solution: OpenCode SKILL.md files must have a YAML frontmatter with `name` and `description` keys at the top of the file. The Engram RAG block must be inserted by the patcher, never hand-written, and must use the canonical v2 topic key `engram-rag/agent-rigor-protocol/v2` only. Forbidden v1 topic aliases (e.g. `engram-rag/agent-rigor-protocol/v1`, `engram-rag/agent-rigor-protocol`, `agent-rigor-protocol`, `engram-rag-protocol`) are rejected by the verifier.
